spans.s: cikitsikā (= Skt. ˚tsā, plus -ka svārthe), medical treatment: MSV 〔ii.140.9〕 ˚tsikāṃ kurmaḥ (in 10 ˚tsāṃ kuryāma; both prose).
cikka, m., or cikkā (n. pl. ˚ās; cf. Skt. cikkaṇa, esp. s.v. 5 in pw), sticky matter, as secreted from the eyes: cikkās tathākṣṇoḥ krimivac ca jantoḥ Śikṣ 〔231.11〕 (vs).
